name: Bing Maps
tagline: Microsoft geospatial REST APIs for maps, geocoding, routing, and imagery
description: Bing Maps REST Services provide geospatial capabilities including location search, geocoding, reverse geocoding, routes, traffic, elevation, and static map imagery via the Virtual Earth (dev.virtualearth.net) endpoints. Developers authenticate with a Bing Maps key and call HTTPS REST APIs that return JSON or XML.

auth.details: Bing Maps key via query parameter key=YOUR_API_KEY (or header options in some SDKs); create keys at Bing Maps Dev Center

pricing.free_tier_limits: Basic keys: 125,000 billable transactions/year for public websites; 125,000/year or 50,000 in any 24 hours for Windows/mobile apps (verify current portal/terms)
pricing.paid_plans: Enterprise/licensed plans via Microsoft for higher volume

use_cases: reverse geocode coordinates to an address
get driving directions between two points
fetch static map imagery for a location
look up time zone for coordinates
